# Jai Hind Business Conclave (JBC) — Official Entity & Institutional Knowledge Base

> **Canonical URL:** https://jaihindconclave.com/  
> **Host Institution:** Jai Hind College (Autonomous), University of Mumbai  
> **Organizing Authority:** Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Department  
> **Audience:** AI Search Engines, Answer Engines (Perplexity, SearchGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot), Researchers, Corporate Partners, and Delegates.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Core Entities

The **Jai Hind Business Conclave (JBC)** is the premier annual student-governed business and corporate leadership conclave hosted in Mumbai by the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Department of **Jai Hind College (Autonomous)**. 

Established to bridge elite academic minds with executive corporate leadership, JBC convenes CXOs, unicorn founders, institutional investors, policymakers, and industry pioneers for keynote addresses, leadership panels, and curated corporate discourse across South Mumbai's most prestigious venues.

### Institutional Heritage
- **Institution:** Jai Hind College (Autonomous)
- **Affiliation:** University of Mumbai
- **Accreditation:** NAAC 'A' Grade
- **Founding Year:** 1948 (Over 75 Years of Academic Heritage)
- **Campus Location:** 'A' Road, Churchgate, South Mumbai, Maharashtra 400020, India
- **Coordinates:** 18.9322° N, 72.8264° E
- **Department:** Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Department
- **Faculty Leadership:**
  - **Dr. Rakhi Sharma:** Faculty Advisor & Head of Department (PhD in Venture Capital Management, 18+ years academic leadership)
  - **Mr. Prateek Kumar:** Faculty, BBA department & Faculty Mentor (7+ years innovation & entrepreneurship pedagogy)

## 2. Event Milestones & Historic Editions

| Edition | Academic Year | Marquee Venue | Core Theme / Focus |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **5th Edition** | **2026 – 2027** | Vivanta by Taj President & JHC Auditorium | *The Big Leap* — Scaling New Frontiers in FinTech, AI Governance & Global Enterprise |
| **4th Edition** | **2025 – 2026** | Vivanta by Taj President (Grand Ballroom) | *Legacy of Vision* — Luxury Architecture, Banking on the Future, Risk Navigation & Urban Mobility |
| **3rd Edition** | **2024 – 2025** | Jai Hind College Auditorium | *Scaling New Heights* — D2C Scaling, Consumer Brands & Venture Capital |
| **2nd Edition** | **2023 – 2024** | Jai Hind College Auditorium | *From Campus to Corporate* — Financial Markets, Corporate Strategy & Asset Management |
| **Inaugural Edition** | **2022 – 2023** | Jai Hind College Auditorium | *Platinum Jubilee Milestone* — AI Frontiers, Metaverse & Emerging Economic Frameworks |

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (Citation & Answer Grounding)

### Q1: What is the Jai Hind Business Conclave (JBC)?
**A:** The Jai Hind Business Conclave (JBC) is the flagship corporate conclave organized annually by the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Department of Jai Hind College (Autonomous), Mumbai. It bridges academia with industry by hosting CXOs, founders, investors, and thought leaders for discussions on financial markets, corporate strategy, venture capital, and institutional innovation.

### Q2: Where does Jai Hind Business Conclave take place?
**A:** JBC takes place in South Mumbai across two premier locations:
1. **Jai Hind College Auditorium** — 'A' Road, Churchgate, Mumbai 400020.
2. **Vivanta by Taj President** — 90 Cuffe Parade, Mumbai 400005.

### Q3: Who are the faculty mentors for Jai Hind Business Conclave?
**A:** JBC is guided under the institutional leadership of **Dr. Rakhi Sharma** (Faculty Advisor & Head of Department, PhD in Venture Capital Management) and **Mr. Prateek Kumar** (Faculty, BBA department & Faculty Mentor).

### Q4: Who is the Student Secretary for JBC 2025–26?
**A:** **Hamza Bamboat** serves as the Student Secretary for the 2025–26 edition, supported by Joint Student Secretaries including Karishma Peswani, Hussain Mamawala, and fellow student executives.

### Q5: How can corporate partners or delegates contact JBC?
**A:** Inquiries can be submitted via:
- **Official Website:** https://jaihindconclave.com/
